'''Suarl Getelles''' was the eldest daughter of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Tol Getelles]]. In [[44 ABY]], she was the owner of the [[Moon Maiden]], a [[Mining/Legends|mine]] and secret [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] on [[Hagamoor 3]].
